title: InternationalPhoneInput
description: A phone number input with country code selector, validation, formatting, paste detection, and copy format support.

value.description: PhoneNumberValue - Controlled phone value with countryCode and phoneNumber fields.

defaultValue.description: PhoneNumberValue - Default phone value for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (data: PhoneNumberData) => void - Fires when the phone number changes, providing full validation data.

onCountryChange.description: (country: CountryOption) => void - Fires when the selected country changes.

defaultCountry.description: ISO country code for the default selected country.

countries.description: Custom list of country options to display.

preferredCountries.description: ISO country codes to show at the top of the country list.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the input.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Helper text displayed below the label.

loading.description: When true, the input is in a loading state.

clearable.description: When true, shows a clear button to reset the phone number.

onClear.description: () => void - Called when the clear button is clicked.

error.description: Displays the input in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the input.

success.description: Displays the input in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the input.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the phone number input.

fullWidth.description: Makes the input span the full width of its container.

validateOnBlur.description: Validates the phone number when the input loses focus.

validationMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Custom validation message shown on blur validation.

validate.description: (data: PhoneNumberData) => boolean | { valid: boolean; message?: string } - Authoritative custom validator. Overrides the built-in length check for both the emitted isValid and the blur error. For real number validation, use createLibphonenumberValidator() from @chumlab/ui/phone-validators.

autoComplete.description: Native input autocomplete. Defaults to "off" so browser autofill can't corrupt the national-number field; pass e.g. "tel-national" to opt in.

enablePasteDetection.description: Enables automatic detection and parsing of pasted phone numbers.

copyFormat.description: Format used when copying the phone number.

onPasteDetected.description: (data: PasteDetectedData) => void - Fires when a phone number paste is detected.

countryDropdownPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the country dropdown.

countrySearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the country search input.

countryDropdownAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the country dropdown.

selectedIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Custom icon for the selected country indicator.

flagSize.description: Pixel width of the flag rendered in the trigger and dropdown options. Height auto-scales at the 22:17 aspect ratio. Defaults to 22.

renderCountryOption.description: (props: CountryOptionRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for country options.

renderSelectedCountry.description: (country: CountryOption) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the selected country display.

formatPatterns.description: Record<string, PhoneFormatPattern> - Custom phone number formatting patterns by country.

lengthRules.description: Record<string, PhoneLengthRule> - Custom phone number length validation rules by country.

className.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles for the root element.

dropdownPosition.description: Vertical placement of the country dropdown relative to the trigger.

forceDropdownPosition.description: Locks the country dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping.

dropdownZIndex.description: Z-index of the country dropdown popup.

dropdownGap.description: Gap in pixels between trigger and country dropdown popup.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null - Portal target for the country dropdown.

lockScroll.description: Locks body scroll while the country dropdown is open.
